g.text: Defense in Depth: How Every Layer Protects Data
Multi-tenant workflow automation · each layer independently limits what a bug or attacker can reach.
Solid border = implemented and covered by the current test suite · dashed border = roadmap contract (Phases 4–9)
Admits only authenticated, workspace-scoped requests into the platform.
Resolves the caller's workspace and verifies membership before dispatch.
Fails closed without a workspace and validates every command before it changes state.
Makes illegal state and cross-workspace references impossible in memory.
Scopes every read to the active workspace and blocks every cross-workspace write.
Independently rejects orphaned, invalid, duplicate, or contradictory rows.
Data at Rest · Secrets & Immutable History
Keeps credentials out of definitions and makes execution snapshots tamper-evident.
Carries tenant identity through queues and makes duplicate or stale deliveries harmless.
Every layer assumes the one above it can fail.
A missed filter is still contained by the write interceptor, the composite foreign key, and the CHECK constraint.
